common:generalComment.#text: Inorganic pigments are materials that change the color of reflected or transmitted light due to wavelength-selective absorption. They are made from minerals and other non-living materials known for their bright and vibrant colours stability and non-toxicity. They use chemical formulations to achieve desired product properties for various applications. Compounds obtained from inorganic metallic compounds and salts such as chromates metallic oxides sulphates etc. are used in inorganic pigments.
无机颜料是一种通过对波长的选择性吸收来改变反射光或透射光颜色的材料。无机颜料由矿物质和其他非生物材料制成，以色彩鲜艳、稳定和无毒而著称。它们使用化学配方来实现各种应用所需的产品特性。无机颜料中使用的化合物来自无机金属化合物和盐类，如铬酸盐、金属氧化物和硫酸盐等。

common:generalComment.#text: Urea (urea), also known as urea, carbamide, chemical formula is CH4N2O or CO(NH2)2, is an organic compound composed of carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, hydrogen, is a white crystal. One of the simplest organic compounds, it is the main nitrogenous end product of protein metabolic breakdown in mammals and certain fish.As a neutral fertilizer, urea is suitable for a variety of soils and plants. It is easy to preserve, easy to use, small damage to the soil, is a large use of a chemical nitrogen fertilizer, but also the highest nitrogen content. In industry, ammonia and carbon dioxide are used to synthesize urea under certain conditions.
尿素（urea）又称尿素、碳酰胺，化学式为 CH4N2O 或 CO(NH2)2，是一种由碳、氮、氧、氢组成的有机化合物，是一种白色晶体。作为一种中性肥料，尿素适用于各种土壤和植物。它易于保存，使用方便，对土壤破坏小，是使用量较大的一种化学氮肥，也是含氮量最高的一种肥料。在工业上，氨和二氧化碳在一定条件下合成尿素。
